raw_translation: Wannan yana kimanta adadin wata kawai. Ba ya tantance halayyar, tarihin gudummawa, lokacin amfani ko hakkin neman. Yana tsammanin aiki na tsawon lokaci kuma yana amfani da mafi ƙarancin da mafi girman ZXQPH0000QXZ SEPE. Aikin lokaci-daki yana amfani da IPREM mai raɗaɗi wanda ba a lissafa shi ba a nan. Ka tabbatar da shigarwa da dokoki na yanzu tare da SEPE.
source: This estimates only a monthly amount. It does not determine eligibility, contribution history, benefit duration or a right to claim. It assumes full-time employment and uses the 2026 SEPE minimums and maximums. Part-time work uses a proportional IPREM cap that is not calculated here. Confirm the inputs and current rules with SEPE.
translation: Wannan yana kimanta adadin wata kawai. Ba ya tantance halayyar, tarihin gudummawa, lokacin amfani ko hakkin neman. Yana tsammanin aiki na tsawon lokaci kuma yana amfani da mafi ƙarancin da mafi girman 2026 SEPE. Aikin lokaci-daki yana amfani da IPREM mai raɗaɗi wanda ba a lissafa shi ba a nan. Ka tabbatar da shigarwa da dokoki na yanzu tare da SEPE.
